sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-225 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR only with SUP-B. There is no approval for SUP-C. The re-audit does not approve any part.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X (Aurelia). A change of source needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP) and 90 days' notice under revision 4, which replaces revision 3. Nothing in force covers it.

sources.quote:
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-225 is drawn in EN AW-6082-T6.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa (SC-BR225-YS). SUP-C is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. T5 has a typical yield of 230 MPa and 6061-T6 has 240 MPa, both below 250.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-C has no 3.1 certificate for MAT-6082-T6, the drawing material of BR-225. The question goes to the SQE (Elena Gallo).
